text:
alex: oncall-bot just paged me for a surge of 503s on the inference gateway, lots of duplicates. seeing PD alerts firing in bursts :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT opened — id: INC-2026-0427. High error rate on /v1/generate across hosted region us-west-2. paging: #eng-oncall. detection: 5xx spike > threshold.

maria: I'm seeing the errors correlate with a sudden jump in token volume to a particular model variant. Could be queue saturation + retries.

jordan: +1. metrics show p95 latency up to 900ms and error rate ~12% over 5m. customer impact: some real-time apps experiencing timeouts.

lee: grabbing runbook. starting live mitigation — will throttle retry-heavy routes and enable short-term dedupe window on PD to reduce noise.

alex: what's current PD noise? it's causing duplicate pages for same incident. we need a quick suppress rule or grouping.

maria: propose: 1) add 2m dedupe window on PD for the specific alert fingerprint 2) apply a rate cap of 10 alerts/min per alert key 3) route remaining alerts to a consolidated channel.

jordan: agree. also let's lower the sensitivity on the gateway 5xx rule from 3%->7% for the next 30m to avoid flapping while we mitigate.

lee: doing the PD suppress patch now. patch snippet: ```yaml
# PD temporary policy
service: inference-gateway
squelch:
  key: alert.fingerprint
  window_seconds: 120
  max_per_window: 1
  route_to: #eng-oncall-consolidated
```

oncall-bot: PD suppression applied by lee at 2187654378. grouping key set to alert.fingerprint.

alex: applied routing change to consolidated channel. can people with access confirm they see single summarized alerts there?

maria: I see aggregated alert message with counts and top traces. much better — no repeated PD pages. :thumbsup:

jordan: started a quick config tweak on the gateway: reduce max inflight per-worker from 64->48 and enable fast-fail for queued requests to reduce downstream retries.

lee: also pushing a temporary autoscaler cap to avoid too many new pods causing noisy metrics.

alex: customer-impact check: which tenants saw errors? list: tenant-alpha (high), tenant-beta (low), tenant-gamma (intermittent). Maria can you confirm any active support tickets?

maria: support team flagged 3 realtime sessions for tenant-alpha. escalated.

jordan: rolling out model-routing fallback — lower-cost variant (v1-small) for non-critical traffic to reduce pressure while we debug. routing rule: ```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","predicate":"user.priority!=high","model":"v1-small"}
```

maria: good call. adding a metric: routed_fallback_count to track how much traffic we divert.

lee: monitoring after changes. error rate dropped to 3.1% in 10m window, p95 latency down to 420ms. PD noise dropped 85%.

alex: nice. next steps: - keep PD suppress for 60m then re-evaluate - create temporary dashboard for this incident with dedupe/aggregation metrics - file a follow-up to tune final thresholds and grouping keys in Alerting infra.

jordan: I'll create the dashboard now (dash id: tmp-infer-218765) and add widgets for: error_rate_by_model, p95_latency, pd_alert_rate, dedupe_hits, fallback_routed_count.

maria: I'll open a post-incident ticket to propose permanent changes: better alert fingerprints (include model id + route + tenant group), PD rate caps, and automated fallback rules for surge patterns.

lee: note for runbook: add explicit step for 'apply PD window' and 'enable fallback routing' under "surge-with-retries". also add sample commands.

alex: any outstanding customer-impact actions?

maria: support is contacting tenant-alpha, offering temporary SLA credit if needed. engineering asked to prioritize fixing the root cause.

jordan: I'm going to collect heap/queue metrics and request logs for the time window and share in this thread.

sre-bot: automation detected sustained improvement >10m. closing automation escalation, incident remains open for manual follow-up.

lee: incident status: mitigation successful, PD noise reduced, customers contacted. will handoff to postmortem. leaving PD suppress until 60m mark.

alex: thanks team. we should schedule a quick retro in 48h to decide permanent alert tuning and dashboard rollout. I'll create a calendar invite and a short summary for the postmortem doc.

maria: TL;DR for post: root suspects: retry storm + model-specific traffic skew. mitigations done: PD dedupe window, temporary threshold raise, route to fallback model, autoscaler cap. action items: permanent alert fingerprinting, PD rate caps, dashboard, runbook updates.

jordan: attaching quick log grep command for traces: ```bash
grep -E "ERROR|timeout|retry" /var/logs/gateway/*.log | sed -n '1200,1400p'
```

lee: I'll add the temporary PD rule to infra repo under playbooks/incident-mitigation/pd-temp-squelch.yml and link in postmortem.

alex: great. last note — let's be careful with raising thresholds for too long. 30-60m window only. close thread when postmortem created. :white_check_mark:
